Site News

Replatforming and Reprogramming

Published December 23rd, 2024

Written by Lucas Mace

Thanks for visiting!

The hosting platform I am using is no longer providing database services for the previous game version. I am currently in the process of finding a new platform to host the game.

I am also in the process of reprogramming the game from scratch so it is easier for me to update and add new parts. The new version will have a "Rookie" mode that won't automatically end the game on a wrong answer, but also won't give you a score. Think of it as a training mode.

I could never have imagined the amazing response from the bicycle mechanic and nerd community that I have received with this game. Thank you all so much for playing and sharing the game with your friends.

If you'd like any news about progress, please follow me at my BlueSky profile or feel free to drop me a line at lucasmace4130@gmail.com.

- Lucas
